tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the live menu of Zest Planche, a Paris caterer (savory and sweet food, apéro boards, cocktail pieces, drinks, bike delivery). Use it whenever the user plans or orders food for a group in Paris (team breakfast, lunch, afterwork, apéro, cocktail dînatoire, seminar, birthday, buffet, traiteur).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full Zest Planche product sheet: composition, allergens, ordering conditions, lead time, variants and prices (cents). Use it when the user asks what a product contains, its allergens or how early to order.

tools.name: get_ordering_guidelines
tools.description: Zest Planche's current rules for sizing an order: quantities per person for each moment, savory / sweet / drinks balance, dietary choices, budget, lead times, delivery and multi-day events; plus the workshops and culinary animations, on-site services and how to request a quote. Call it before sugges

tools.name: build_basket
tools.description: Validate and price a Zest Planche basket, and get the link that opens zestplanche.com with it in the cart. Use it when the user wants a total price or an order link, or when the interactive shop cannot be shown. Quantities below a product's minimum are raised to it and reported in `issues`.

tools.name: open_shop
tools.description: Show the interactive Zest Planche shop, where the user browses products, adjusts quantities and checks out on zestplanche.com. Call it to end every order composition, pre-filled with your suggested items, right after presenting the selection. It only shows an editable preview: nothing is ordered unt

tools.name: shop_catalog
tools.description: Catalog payload for the shop view.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the Zest Planche catalog; best sellers of the moment come first." → after: "Search the live menu of Zest Planche, a Paris caterer (savory and sweet food, apéro boards, cocktail pieces, drinks, bike delivery). Use it whenever the user plans or orders food for a group in Paris (team breakfast, lunch, afterwork, apéro, cocktail dînatoire, seminar, birthday, buffet, traiteur). "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
